input.number: Preserved SenderParticipantId reference, positive integer; must equal same-Invoker server-resolved participant.
input.text: NEW REQUIRED IntentId UUID; one ID per explicit send intent, reused unchanged after invocation/unknown failure.

output.status: Text saved status; REPLAY may be terminal history
output.resultcode: SAVED / REPLAY / CONNECTION_EXISTS / UNSETTLED_CONNECTION_EXISTS / INTENT_CONFLICT / CREATE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN / schema/read/availability failures

runtimeSchemaGate: Before request item reads/writes validate list identity/type, complete metadata, expected types/lookup targets/choices; both keys required unique indexed Text. No schema writes.
schemaMappingStatus: List ID observed in supplied Send export; proposed coordination/custom-field types/constraints not tenant observed. Run shared metadata preflight first.

proposedFields.RecipientParticipant: Optional single Participants Lookup; value required for Personal
proposedFields.TargetGroup: Optional single Groups Lookup; null for Personal

authority: Same Invoker SharePoint currentuser -> exactly one ParticipantaccountId match -> sender input equality before request/candidate reads. No owner fallback. Ordinary-user private access remains unverified.
send: Replay immutable existing send before availability checks. Fresh creation requires both sides Active validation/participation/open, maintained #9 pair fit, no live connection key and no legacy Pending or Accepted-incomplete pair; no personal introduction.
writeBoundary: One request POST only; both native unique constraints arbitrate races, automatic retry disabled. Exact immutable SendOperationKey readback can settle a lost response; failed/unknown create without exact row returns CREATE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, never claims no effect. No membership/group/notification/profile/permission writes.
receiptScope: Minimal immutable personal intent has only trusted actor and target; uniquely keyed request row itself is send receipt. No separate operation store or lock platform introduced. Completed/history replay never creates a fresh request.
recovery: Keep same intent after unknown transport outcome. Reverse concurrent send may return unknown when other intent owns live key; refresh My requests. Never make a new UUID automatically as a retry workaround.
prerequisites: Request schema/mapping and existing rows must be reviewed; preflight is read-only and does not apply constraints/backfill.
All replacement request writers must adopt same keys/decision protocol before cutover; old exported send/cancel do not populate/rekey the new fields.
Do not alter old flows or published app while import-previewing; #11/#17/#65 integration remains separately owned.
